title: Migration assessment pack release rubric
appliesTo: Synthetic legacy-app Bob assessment and one Java invoice-preview pilot
evidencePolicy: Score the actual artifact versions and recorded checks. Public methods guide structure but do not validate demo claims. Unknown client facts may be disclosed with an owner and validation action; they may not be fabricated.
scoreType: ordinal; do not sum, average, or report a percentage

scoreMeaning.NR: Not reviewed or check not run; never a pass
scoreMeaning.1: Present but materially incomplete or weakly evidenced
scoreMeaning.2: Complete for the declared scope, traceable to evidence, and candid about unresolved inputs

blockingFailures.name: fabricated_evidence_or_approval
blockingFailures.trigger: Any invented command result, runtime observation, stakeholder statement, signature, acceptance, consent, or institutional endorsement
blockingFailures.repair: Remove or relabel the claim, restore actual evidence and pending approval state, then rerun affected review

blockingFailures.name: wrong_money
blockingFailures.trigger: Currency amount without an authorized rate basis, currency/tax treatment, or correct arithmetic; or Bobcoin spend presented as SI labor price
blockingFailures.repair: Mark unpriced or recompute from documented approved inputs and reconcile every total

blockingFailures.name: unjustified_dead_code
blockingFailures.trigger: Code called dead or safe to remove solely from inspected static references without checking routes, reflection, configuration, generated use, tests, and residual uncertainty
blockingFailures.repair: Narrow the claim to inspected paths or provide additional checks and owner/runtime validation

blockingFailures.name: false_cve_reachability
blockingFailures.trigger: CVE/version match treated as confirmed exploitable, unreachable, fixed, or clean without component, affectedness, execution-path, and test or scan evidence
blockingFailures.repair: Record scan scope and exact status justification; otherwise classify under investigation

blockingFailures.name: nontraceable_estimate_or_schedule
blockingFailures.trigger: Material effort, duration, savings, or milestone claim lacks WBS/role basis, calculation, assumption, predecessor, or evidence pointer
blockingFailures.repair: Rebuild and reconcile the model and dependent plan, or remove the unsupported number

blockingFailures.name: pilot_scope_confusion
blockingFailures.trigger: One Java preview pilot is represented as full migration, production deployment, security clearance, validated savings, or implementation of other target cases
blockingFailures.repair: Separate observed pilot facts from future forecast and narrow acceptance to executed checks

blockingFailures.name: reference_or_secret_leakage
blockingFailures.trigger: IDEAL or held-out answer material is supplied to Bob, native provenance is obscured, or a secret appears in the pack or prompt evidence
blockingFailures.repair: Stop release, remove exposed material from output, preserve an incident record, and rerun clean provenance checks

blockingFailures.name: overwritten_original_or_unverified_correction
blockingFailures.trigger: Original native Bob output is lost, or a material correction is released without rerunning its affected check
blockingFailures.repair: Restore original from native run evidence, version the correction, and record new checks

blockingFailures.name: unresolved_template_or_internal_scaffold
blockingFailures.trigger: A released client/SI draft contains unresolved template fields, synthetic example rows presented as findings, or internal authoring instructions presented as report content
blockingFailures.repair: Replace the scaffold with evidence-linked Bob-authored content, retain the rejected version, and rerun completeness and semantic review

blockingFailures.name: cross_artifact_identity_drift
blockingFailures.trigger: A finding, WBS, deliverable, artifact, source revision or target profile changes meaning or disappears across the assessment, annexes, CSV, plan, SOW and ledger
blockingFailures.repair: Reconcile the authoritative identifiers and meanings, version each affected artifact, and rerun traceability, arithmetic and dependency checks

blockingFailures.name: bob_price_arithmetic
blockingFailures.trigger: A Bob-authored report states a currency amount, a rate-times-hours product, a risk-allowance amount or any other price figure instead of referencing the SI commercial engine's illustrative table labelled not a quote
blockingFailures.repair: Remove the figure from Bob's prose, reference the engine-calculated illustrative table, and rerun the price cross-check with check_effort_numbers.py

blockingFailures.name: ticket_as_sole_proof
blockingFailures.trigger: A finding, severity or recommendation rests only on synthetic help-desk ticket or incident records, or a ticket is presented as a diagnosis rather than a user report
blockingFailures.repair: Bind the claim to inspected source or other primary evidence and cite the ticket only as corroboration, or downgrade the claim to an open question with an owner

blockingFailures.name: unmeasured_complexity_or_calibrated_velocity_claim
blockingFailures.trigger: Complexity is presented as measured by Bob, SI-measured metrics are presented without the SI-measured, Bob-scored label, or delivery velocity is presented as calibrated without measured pilot actuals
blockingFailures.repair: Relabel metrics as SI-measured, Bob-scored, cite the metrics input, restore the statement velocity not calibrated, and rerun affected effort and plan checks

criteria.score0: No clear recommendation or a recommendation contradicted by findings
criteria.score1: Recommendation exists but decision owner, blocker, or reversal condition is absent
criteria.score2: Page-one recommendation, reason, pending decision owner, blockers, and evidence that could change it link to findings

criteria.score0: Synthetic status, source revision, or Bob versus Codex authorship is false or absent
criteria.score1: Origins or exclusions stated but versions, run IDs, or pilot boundary are incomplete
criteria.score2: BASE, IDEAL, MIGRATION, COMPARISON, version, date, run IDs, scope, and exclusions are distinguishable and traceable

criteria.score0: Architecture and inventory asserted without evidence
criteria.score1: Build/runtime, data, interfaces, or target constraints only partly inspected
criteria.score2: Observed build/config/data/interface facts cite paths or runs; unverified topology and target constraints are explicit

criteria.score0: Static references presented as complete runtime behavior
criteria.score1: Dependencies listed but missing evidence class, operational gaps, or validation owner
criteria.score2: Each material dependency distinguishes source inference from runtime evidence; batch, volume, SLA, backup/DR, owner gaps have actions

criteria.score0: Unsupported safety/exploitability claim or hidden scan gap
criteria.score1: Findings listed but scan scope, CVE status, or remediation evidence incomplete
criteria.score2: Code/config, scan, affectedness, reachability and remediation claims separated; exact evidence or visible unperformed checks

criteria.score0: Target choice asserted without driver or alternatives
criteria.score1: Alternatives named but effort, disruption, risk, or decision trigger absent
criteria.score2: Retain/contain, bounded migration, and deeper modernization compared against drivers, disruption, evidence, and open decisions

criteria.score0: Pilot outcome absent, invented, or described as completed migration
criteria.score1: Pilot change recorded but missing revision, executed result, before/after behavior, failure, or boundary
criteria.score2: One Java preview objective, changed files, exact runs, observed behavior, rollback status, and untested scope documented

criteria.score0: No editable WBS model or totals cannot be reconciled
criteria.score1: Role/task range exists but quantity, basis, uncertainty, status, or arithmetic is incomplete
criteria.score2: Versioned WBS/role low-central-high scenarios reconcile and separate actual pilot, assessment, forecast, and unpriced money

criteria.score0: Unlinked dates or plan claims completion beyond observed scope
criteria.score1: Tasks listed but resource, predecessor, duration basis, or exit evidence missing
criteria.score2: WBS links, roles, predecessors, client dependencies, duration basis, gates, and acceptance evidence align with estimate; delay test passes

criteria.score0: Binding, priced, approved, or missing objective deliverable acceptance
criteria.score1: Draft status clear but reviewer, evidence, responsibility, exclusion, or correction cycle incomplete
criteria.score2: Nonbinding unpriced draft has aligned deliverable IDs, measurable acceptance, pending reviewer, client inputs, exclusions, and change trigger

criteria.score0: Headline claims cannot be located in evidence or native Bob evidence lost
criteria.score1: Ledger exists but material claims, versions, or independent checks have gaps
criteria.score2: Findings, recommendation, annex, CSV, plan, SOW, Bob runs and independent checks form a navigable chain with originals preserved

criteria.score0: No challenge record or material discrepancy ignored
criteria.score1: Challenges recorded but corrections or affected reruns missing
criteria.score2: Reviewer challenged claims, money, dependencies, security, pilot and leakage; material fixes versioned and affected checks rerun

criteria.score0: Generic debt score or quality label replaces inspected poor-practice findings
criteria.score1: Some documentation, coupling, dead-code, duplication, testability, error/data, dependency or operations categories are omitted or weakly linked to impact
criteria.score2: Every inspected legacy-health category has evidence-linked findings or an explicit scoped gap, with business/operational impact and a bounded treatment decision

criteria.score0: One or more of the seven target profiles is absent or represented as implemented without evidence
criteria.score1: All targets are named but impacted components, alternatives, compatibility, invariants, feasibility, rollback, effort or owner decisions are incomplete
criteria.score2: All seven annexes consistently link findings and cover options, impacted components, compatibility, behavior, evidence scope, delivery/rollback, WBS uncertainty and pending decisions

criteria.score0: Plan lacks accountable roles, review gates or traceable delivery records
criteria.score1: Roles or Git/ticket/wiki checkpoints exist but sign-offs, evidence locations, cadence or simulation limits are unclear
criteria.score2: WBS work maps to distinct implementation/review/QA/PM responsibilities, Git and ticket/wiki evidence, gates, escalation and candid synthetic/authentication limits

criteria.score0: Discovery records only component-level edges and no documentation state per component
criteria.score1: Some documentation notes or method-level call edges exist but components are missing or pointers lack exact file and line
criteria.score2: Every inspected code component has a documentation note and material method-level call edges cite exact file:line pointers that pass the normalize_evidence.py source check

criteria.score0: Technical debt is a narrative or unexplained score, or complexity is presented as measured by Bob
criteria.score1: Debt is scored but the rubric, the SI-measured metrics input or the SI-measured, Bob-scored label is missing for some components
criteria.score2: Each component's debt score follows a stated rubric, cites the SI-measured metrics input and the linked findings, and is labelled SI-measured, Bob-scored

criteria.score0: Options are asserted without a named path framework or stated scoring criteria
criteria.score1: A framework or criteria exist but retire, retain, rehost, relocate, repurchase, replatform or refactor is unassessed, or business criticality is absent
criteria.score2: Every component is classified against all seven paths with reasons for rejected paths, and options are scored on stated criteria including business criticality, effort and risk

criteria.score0: Ticket or incident records are ignored without explanation, or used as sole proof of a finding
criteria.score1: Tickets are cited but code relevance, the user-report nature or the primary evidence beside them is unclear
criteria.score2: Ticket and incident records are classified as code-relevant or not, cited only as corroboration beside primary evidence, and security wording states a source-reading review, no scanner

criteria.score0: No per-module work packages, no staffing or a calibrated-velocity claim
criteria.score1: Per-module effort or roster staffing exists but skills, named synthetic people, skills gaps or the calibration protocol are incomplete
criteria.score2: Each work package has a component column, required skills, named synthetic roster people with gaps flagged, and a pilot velocity calibration protocol that keeps velocity not calibrated

criteria.score0: Bob states price figures, or effort roles cannot be traced to the rate card
criteria.score1: Rate-card roles or risk drivers are named but some effort roles are unmapped, or the illustrative table, not-a-quote label or numeric cross-check is missing
criteria.score2: Every effort role maps to a rate-card role or states that no rate exists, risk drivers are chosen without arithmetic, and the SOW references the engine's illustrative table as not a quote with check_effort_numbers.py cross-checking every figure

releaseRule: Release as client/SI review draft only when all required pack items exist, every Q criterion scores 2, no B failure remains, and affected checks after corrections have recorded evidence. NR, 0, or 1 means revise; this is an ordinal gate, not a percentage grade. Human approval remains pending.
